signal: Magic raised a $10M seed in Oct 2025 led by Lerer Hippeau to build AI for real-world experiences, with backers including Major Food Group and Floodgate

email.body1:
Juliena, saw Magic closed its $10M seed led by Lerer Hippeau to build AI for real-world experiences.

Right after a raise, business development usually faces more target accounts and partners than the team can cover before new hires ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Magic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Juliena, quick follow-up for Magic.

Post-seed, investor expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most BD teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Magic needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Juliena, last bit of proof for Magic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Magic's reply rate likely compares to other seed-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Juliena, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The seed-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything right after a raise.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a seed-stage motion? I'll tailor it to Magic either way.
